administration: One fresh subject per case. Deliver only the input and applicable repository role instructions (never this rubric or previous answers). Use the stated target role. Use fictional facts and effects only. No credential, host, external service, production, file mutation or nested evaluator actions. For D08/D09 supply the real matching tool state or mark not_run. Do not simulate orchestration outcomes. Capture actual messages and tool activity separately. Native host prompts, hidden reasoning and billing are outside the observable budget. Each visible input incl attached instructions and output is bounded in UTF-8 bytes, a conservative token upper bound for byte-based BPE; no conversion or claim about hidden usage. Above cap = fail. Check visible inputs before dispatch; require subject output <=800 UTF-8 bytes, stop further rounds on overrun, and mark it failed.
